title: The Dented Watering Can
youtube_title: The Dented Watering Can | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is giving care to something that is not only yours.
summary: On a hot afternoon Asha notices Mr. Okonkwo's seedlings drooping while he is at the market, and she uses the dented watering can he left for her to give them a gentle drink.
